question.text: SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations are dated:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI PIT Regulations 2015 (as amended). **The Trap:** Other dates apply to other regulations. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in III-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Refresh the PIT Code of Conduct annually and circulate to Designated Persons.
